concepts.title: Friendship between Gajaraj and Buntee
concepts.section: The Unlikely Best Friends, Let us read
concepts.definition: The story shows friendship as care given freely between two very different animals: an elephant shares food, baths and rides with a stray dog, and the dog refuses to stay away from him even when taken home.
concepts.formula: friend = one who shares, plays and misses you
concepts.key_idea: Gajaraj and Buntee choose each other; both stop eating when separated, which proves the bond.
concepts.textbook_ref: fepr102.txt, The Unlikely Best Friends, Let us read

concepts.title: Gajaraj the Elephant: Character and Feelings
concepts.section: The Unlikely Best Friends, Let us read
concepts.definition: Gajaraj is a royal elephant who lacks nothing except company; his sadness without a friend and his refusal to eat show that affection matters more to him than comfort.
concepts.key_idea: Actions such as sharing food and lifting Buntee with the trunk reveal Gajaraj's gentle, playful nature.

concepts.title: Caretaker versus Friend
concepts.section: The Unlikely Best Friends, Let us think and reflect
concepts.definition: The mahout feeds and bathes Gajaraj as a good caretaker, yet a friend is the one you play with and miss. The story draws this line clearly and then erases it when mahout and farmer also become friends.
concepts.key_idea: Service meets the body's needs, friendship meets the heart's needs; the story needs both.

concepts.title: Word Meanings: Strayed, Munching and Winced
concepts.section: The Unlikely Best Friends, Let us learn
concepts.definition: The story's glossary words are worked out from context: strayed means came by mistake, munching means chewing, and winced means shrunk back in pain or distress.
concepts.key_idea: Each new word sits beside clues, like the dog arriving tired and hungry, that fix its meaning.

worked_examples.source_ref: fepr102.txt, Let us think and reflect I.2
worked_examples.question_pattern: Why did the farmer remove the rope from Buntee's neck?

solution_template.explain: Buntee had not touched food since he was brought home.
The farmer sees the dog is missing his friend and lets him go, saying he cannot watch him go hungry.

worked_examples.question_pattern: How did Gajaraj treat the tired visitor on the first evening?

solution_template.explain: A hungry stray enters the stable late one evening.
Gajaraj pushes his own food towards the dog and lets him sleep in the stable.
